description: Land Title Settlement Department - Mariyawatta, Udapalatha D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320015
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains multiple declarations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement determining ownership of specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, cadastral maps, locations, and owner details) in various villages. The content focuses entirely on land property rights, title settlements, and land registration processes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
